SELECT
    d.calendar_year_number AS year,
    COUNT(f.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel AS c ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE c.display_name = 'Mobile App'
  AND d.calendar_year_number IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  t1.currency_code,
  SUM(t1.original_amount) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer AS t1
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS t2 ON t1.business_date_key = t2.date_key
WHERE
  t2.calendar_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.calendar_date <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  t1.currency_code
ORDER BY
  total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;
